bins.title: Put the bins out
bins.description: "Put out tonight: Papier & karton + Pmd", to whoever has the bins task (or everyone). Time: the bins task's own time, or an evening hour you pick.

title: Waste collection
description: Your collector's calendar, synced daily. Collections show up on the calendar and the dashboard.

limburg-net.hint: For the municipalities of the province of Limburg (postal codes 3500–3999).

recycle-app.hint: The Recycle! app by Fost Plus: most other Belgian municipalities, e.g. IVAGO (Ghent), IVBO, Mirom, Interza, Bruxelles-Propreté.

setup.title: Connect your waste collector
setup.description: Pick your collector and find your address at it. We suggest one from your postal code.
setup.mainMunicipality: Limburg.net uses the main municipality, e.g. Hasselt instead of Kermt.
setup.foundOne: Found at the collector. Is this your address?
setup.saved: Collector connected. The collection days are on your calendar.
setup.savedSyncFailed: Collector saved, but the collection days couldn't be fetched yet. We'll try again later.
setup.invalidMatch: Pick an address from the search results first.
setup.readOnly: Only adults can set up the waste collector.

problems.not_covered: {{provider}} doesn't serve this postal code. Try another collector.
problems.municipality: {{provider}} doesn't know this municipality. Check the spelling or use the main municipality.
problems.street: {{provider}} doesn't know this street in this municipality. Check the spelling.
problems.number: {{provider}} doesn't know this house number in this street.
problems.provider_error: {{provider}} couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.

sync.failed: Refreshing failed; the last known collection days are kept.
sync.tooSoon: Just refreshed. Try again in a moment.

upcoming.title: Next collections
upcoming.empty: No collections in the next weeks.
upcoming.calendar: All collection days are on the household calendar.

remove.title: Disconnect the waste collector?
remove.description: The collection days disappear from the calendar and the dashboard. You can connect again any time.

card.title: Waste collection
card.notSetUp: Connect your waste collector to see here which bins go out, and when.
card.none: No collections in the next weeks.
card.syncError: The collector couldn't be reached on the last update.

sync.title: Sync the waste calendar
sync.description: Fetches the collection days from your collector every morning, for the calendar, the dashboard and the bins tasks.

tasks.enabled: Create a task to put the bins out
tasks.enabledHint: One task per collection day on the total task list, for the coming two weeks.
tasks.whoHint: Nobody picked: the tasks stay unassigned and you can assign each one.
tasks.rotateHint: One person per collection day, in the order picked.
